title: WFO Opens Search for Its Next Secretary-General
html:
The World Federation of Orthodontists (WFO) is inviting applications for the position of Secretary-General, the Federation’s chief executive and financial officer. Applications are due by Jan 31, 2027.

The Secretary-General leads the WFO’s day-to-day operations and serves the Executive Committee, the Council and the General Assembly. The appointment is for a five-year term, with an anticipated start date of Apr 1, 2027.

Key Dates:

Call Opens: November 20, 2026
Application Deadline: January 31, 2027
Anticipated Start Date: April 1, 2027

About the role

The Secretary-General manages the Secretariat, oversees the Federation’s finances and reports all actions to the Executive Committee. The position is salaried, with salary or stipend and other terms of employment to be negotiated.

The Secretariat is currently headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, but the Secretary-General does not need to be based there.
Term: Five (5) years. The Secretary-General may serve no more than two (2) terms.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leadership and operations. Lead the Federation’s day-to-day operations, oversee the administrative and management operations of the International Orthodontic Congress (IOC), and manage the Secretariat, including its headquarters and staff. He also reports all actions to the Executive Committee.
  • Financial stewardship. Collect, manage and disburse all Federation funds, submit an annual budget to the Executive Committee, and deliver a profit and loss summary after each fiscal year.
  • Membership and partnerships. Negotiate dues incentives (discounts, group rates, payment incentives or similar) with WFO-affiliated national organizations in exchange for the unanimous membership of their orthodontist members. Each agreement goes to the Executive Committee for ratification before it takes effect.

Who should apply
Applicants must meet all seven of the following requirements:

  1. Be a licensed or credentialed orthodontist in good standing.
  2. Be a national (citizen) of the United States of America.
  3. Be able to work effectively with the Federation’s central office.
  4. Have previous governance or academic experience, such as board or committee service, or university faculty or program leadership.
  5. Have previous voluntary leadership experience in professional, scientific, civic or non-profit organizations.
  6. Have experience working across continents, with demonstrated international engagement.
  7. Demonstrate global sensibilities and the ability to work respectfully, diplomatically and affably with global leaders and diverse cultures.

The search committee will also value:

  • Experience managing budgets, staff or an association secretariat
  • Experience negotiating with national or regional professional bodies
  • Experience with multilingual or multicultural stakeholder engagement
  • Familiarity with the structure of international federations and their member societies

How to apply

Send your application as a single PDF, in English, to wfo@wfo.org by Jan 31, 2027, with a copy to the WFO President, Dr. Letizia Perillo. Use the subject line “Secretary-General Application – [Surname]”.

Your application should include:

  1. A cover letter (maximum 2 pages) addressing the mandatory requirements point by point
  2. A current curriculum vitae
  3. Proof of orthodontic licensure or credentials, and proof of U.S. nationality
  4. A vision statement (maximum 3 pages) on how you would lead the Federation
  5. A summary of your governance, academic and voluntary leadership roles, with dates
  6. A summary of your international experience, naming the continents and countries involved
  7. Three professional references, including at least one from outside the United States
  8. A signed declaration of any conflicts of interest

Incomplete or late applications will not be considered. All applications will be treated confidentially.

Selection process

A dedicated search committee will interview applicants and submit its recommendations to the Executive Committee for hiring. The Executive Committee may extend the deadline or decline to appoint if no candidate is suitable.

Applicants must disclose any actual or potential conflicts of interest. Canvassing members of the Executive Committee about this appointment may result in disqualification.

Questions about the call can be sent to wfo@wfo.org.
